settings.lanHelp: Off (recommended): sites only answer on this PC. On: other devices on your network (e.g. your phone) can open them using this PC's IP, and Windows may ask about the firewall. Adminer stays available only on this PC.
settings.wwwHelp: Each folder inside is a site <folder>.test.
settings.savedLater: Saved. It applies the next time you start the services.
lang.title: Language
shims.title: php and composer in the terminal
shims.help: Adds {dir} to your user PATH (no admin needed), so you can use php and composer in any terminal with the PHP version selected in Kiltro. When you switch versions, they follow.
shims.added: Done. Terminals that were already open won't see it: close them and open a new one.
shims.removed: Removed from the PATH. Terminals that were already open still see it until you close them.
ca.help: Removes from Windows the Kiltro certificate installed when HTTPS was enabled. Browsers will stop trusting https://*.test. Windows asks you to confirm.
ca.done: Kiltro's certificate was removed from Windows. HTTPS is now disabled.
about.title: About
tray.startAllTip: Starts PHP, MySQL, Redis and Nginx
tray.quitTip: Stops the services and closes Kiltro

dev.warning:
Development mode without KILTRO_ROOT: Kiltro is using {root} as its app folder (there is no bin, www or data there). Close wails dev and start it like this, from the project folder:
$env:KILTRO_ROOT = "$PWD\runtime"; wails dev
